info.title: EU VAT Number Validation API
info.description: Validates EU VAT numbers against registered records and returns the registered name and address. Pre-launch design; endpoints are not live yet.

servers.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet and answer 503.

get.description: Checks a country code and VAT number against EU records and returns validity plus registered name and address when available.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Two-letter ISO country code of the VAT number.

parameters.name: vat_number
parameters.description: The VAT number to validate, including the country prefix.

503.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet.
